name: Family Law Attorneys

pitch.painPoint: Family law is one of the most urgently-searched legal categories there is — someone searching 'divorce lawyer near me' at 11pm hires whoever looks most credible online in that moment.

notes: High-trust, high-stakes purchase — people search in crisis, often at odd hours, and pick based on credibility signals (real site, clear practice areas, attorney bios) over price. Retainers commonly run well past the avg job value used here.
